description: This source file defines the DocumentRepository class, which manages CRUD operations for Document entities in the app. It includes methods for creating documents from bitmaps, retrieving all documents, and searching documents. The class uses Room database and handles file storage for images.

classes.name: DocumentRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations for Document entities, manages storage and retrieval of document images.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern to provide a single instance of DocumentRepository.

methods.name: createDocumentFromBitmap
methods.description: Creates a new Document from a Bitmap image and saves it to database and storage.

methods.name: getAllDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves all Document entries from the database.

methods.name: searchDocuments
methods.description: Searches documents in the database matching the query.

methods.name: saveBitmap
methods.description: Saves a Bitmap image to external files directory and returns the file path.
